You are reviewing a small uncommitted Go diff in the repo at /Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.entire/worktrees/pfleidi-cor-1430-cli-enable-async-mirror-creation-by-default (run all commands from there; do not cd elsewhere). Angle: REUSE. Flag new code that re-implements something the codebase already has, and name the existing helper to call instead. Do not hunt for correctness bugs.

Requirements the diff must preserve: async mirror creation is the effective default; explicit `async_mirror_requests: false` survives settings read-modify-write saves; an unset setting remains absent when saved.

The diff (git diff HEAD):

- cmd/entire/cli/repo_mirror.go: `opts.async = settings.AsyncMirrorRequests` → `opts.async = settings.IsAsyncMirrorRequestsEnabled()`
- cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings.go:
  - field `AsyncMirrorRequests bool` → `AsyncMirrorRequests *bool` with json `async_mirror_requests,omitempty`, comment "Nil defaults to true."
  - loadMergedSettings: `loadFromFileWithDefaults(settingsFileAbs, EntireSettings{Enabled: true, AsyncMirrorRequests: true})` → `loadFromFile(settingsFileAbs)`
  - removed `loadFromFileWithDefaults`; `loadFromFile` now inlines `settings := &EntireSettings{Enabled: true}`
  - mergeScalarFields: `mergeRawBool(raw, "async_mirror_requests", &settings.AsyncMirrorRequests)` → `mergeRawBoolPtr(raw, "async_mirror_requests", &settings.AsyncMirrorRequests)`
  - new method:
    ```go
    // IsAsyncMirrorRequestsEnabled reports whether mirror creation uses the async request route.
    func (s *EntireSettings) IsAsyncMirrorRequestsEnabled() bool {
        return s.AsyncMirrorRequests == nil || *s.AsyncMirrorRequests
    }
    ```
- cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings_test.go: existing test switched to the accessor; new table test `TestSave_PreservesAsyncMirrorRequestsPresence` that writes a settings file via setupSettingsDir, LoadFromFile, Save, then reads the raw JSON with os.ReadFile + json.Unmarshal into map[string]json.RawMessage and checks presence/value of `async_mirror_requests`.

Check specifically: (1) how other `*bool` settings fields with nil-means-true semantics are handled in settings.go (e.g. SignCheckpointCommits / IsSignCheckpointCommitsEnabled, and any `mergeRawBoolPtr` callers) and whether the new accessor and merge call match that convention or duplicate something; (2) whether settings_test.go already has a helper for reading back raw saved JSON (search for `json.RawMessage`, `os.ReadFile(EntireSettingsFile`, `readRawSettings`, etc.) that the new test should use; (3) whether a `boolPtr`/`ptr` helper exists in the test file for building pointer bools. Report findings as: file, line, one-line summary, concrete cost, and the existing helper to use. If nothing to flag, say so plainly.

- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. REUSE review of the diff. Three findings, one of them worth acting on before merge.

**1. `/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.entire/worktrees/pfleidi-cor-1430-cli-enable-async-mirror-creation-by-default/cmd/entire/cli/repo_mirror.go:497-499` — re-implements the settings package's "load-or-default" ctx accessor convention, and gets the default backwards.**

The call site hand-rolls the load:

```go
opts := mirrorCreateOptions{noWait: noWait, timeout: waitTimeout}
if settings, err := LoadEntireSettings(cmd.Context()); err == nil {
    opts.async = settings.IsAsyncMirrorRequestsEnabled()
}
```

Every other nil-means-true `*bool` setting already ships a package-level twin that owns the fallback: `settings.IsSignCheckpointCommitsEnabled(ctx)` (settings.go:1947, `return true` on load error), `settings.IsTelemetryEnabled(ctx)` (settings.go:1748), `settings.IsFilteredFetchesEnabled(ctx)` (settings.go:1729). Concrete cost: `LoadEntireSettings` fails whenever `paths.RequireEntireDir` fails (config.go:52-55) — i.e. running `entire repo mirror create` outside an initialized `.entire` repo, which is a normal way to use this command — and `opts.async` then keeps its zero value `false`, silently taking the sync route. That contradicts the "async is the effective default" requirement and the help text added two lines above. Existing helper to mirror: add `func IsAsyncMirrorRequestsEnabled(ctx context.Context) bool` beside `IsSignCheckpointCommitsEnabled(ctx)` at settings.go:1946-1953 (returning `true` on error) and call it here instead of the inline `if err == nil` block.

**2. `/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.entire/worktrees/pfleidi-cor-1430-cli-enable-async-mirror-creation-by-default/cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings_test.go:690-699` — new test re-implements `LoadProjectRaw`.**

The test does `os.ReadFile(EntireSettingsFile)` then `json.Unmarshal(data, &raw)` into `map[string]json.RawMessage`. The package already exports exactly that: `LoadProjectRaw(ctx)` (settings.go:716, impl `loadRaw` at settings.go:760-777) resolves the project settings path and returns `map[string]json.RawMessage` plus an `exists` flag. The test is in `package settings`, so it can call it directly. Cost: ~10 duplicated lines of IO/parse/error boilerplate, and it bypasses the raw accessor the package's own doc comment says callers should use for read-modify-write flows. Replace with `_, raw, _, err := LoadProjectRaw(context.Background())`. Only caveat: the failure message currently prints `data`; use `raw` (or drop it) after the swap.

**3. `boolPtr`/`ptr` test helper — nothing to reuse, and nothing needed.**

There is no `boolPtr` in `cmd/entire/cli/settings/` (the only one in the repo is unexported `boolPtrV` in `/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.entire/worktrees/pfleidi-cor-1430-cli-enable-async-mirror-creation-by-default/cmd/entire/cli/mdrender/mdrender.go:223`, wrong package). Both new/changed tests drive through JSON strings via `setupSettingsDir`, so no pointer literals are needed. No action.

**Not flagged (checked, all clean):**
- `IsAsyncMirrorRequestsEnabled()` (settings.go:1934-1937) is character-for-character the `IsSignCheckpointCommitsEnabled()` convention (settings.go:1941-1944). No generic "bool-ptr with default" helper exists to reuse, so this is convention-matching, not duplication. Only nit: the sibling documents "Defaults to true when the setting is not explicitly set" in the accessor doc comment, while the new one leaves that on the struct field.
- `mergeRawBoolPtr(raw, "async_mirror_requests", ...)` (settings.go:1300) is the same call shape as the `telemetry` (1306) and `sign_checkpoint_commits` (1309) callers — correct helper, no new merge code.
- `loadFromFileWithDefaults` removal has no orphaned callers repo-wide; the inlined `&EntireSettings{Enabled: true}` in `loadFromFile` (settings.go:1028) is the sole default site, not a re-implementation.
- The new table test does not overlap `TestLoad_AcceptsValidKeys` (settings_test.go:114) or `TestLoad_AsyncMirrorRequestsUsesLayeredSettings` (settings_test.go:641) — save-presence vs. layered-read are genuinely different concerns.
